title: RUN GOALS
why: His yes to run goals: three tiny goals per raid, each paying a score chip, the same in DEMO and CAREER. Every raid now draws three small goals from a pool of eight: 10 kills, search 6 crates, survive 3 waves, call an air strike, open a vault, down 3 pillagers, kill an elite, down a warden. They are listed in a panel under the minimap (under the conditions panel in CAREER) with a count, and a goal you meet pays its chip into the run score at once, with GOAL DONE and the amount on screen. The same seed always draws the same three, so a party sharing a seed shares its goals. The vault goal is left out of a map with no vault. The raids themselves are unchanged: the goals are drawn on a side stream, not from the stream that builds the map.
now: Every raid now has three small run goals in a panel, each paying a score chip when met.
